title.narrative: Score of child protection system of Ghana, Text
Child protection priorities are fully reflected in the planning, budgeting, implementation and reporting process at national and decentralized level, Text

baseline.value: Child protection indicators are included in MMDAs annual action plans but current coding for budget does not track child protection activities and expenditures at national and sub-national level

target.value: 2027:All 261 MMDAs report the progress on an annual basis against child protection indicators in the Medium-Term Development Plans 2022-2025 and its subsequent plans 2026-2029

actual.value: 2025:Yes, annual reports of all 261 districts include child protection indicators

title.narrative: National legislative and policy frameworks are in place in line with international standards related to protection of children and women from violence, exploitation, and abuse, Text

baseline.value: Partial amendment made to the Childrens Act (2021); No amendments made to the Justice for Children Act nor to the Criminal Procedure Act in line with international standards (2022)

target.value: 2027:Legislative Instrument to Children's Act and Juvenile Justice Act are drafted

actual.value: 2025:Proposed amendments to the Children's Act and Juvenile Justice Act finalised and memo in the process of being submitted to Cabinet
